# Bingo Network — runtime dependencies.
#
# Direct deps only (no transitive junk). Generated by hand from what the app
# actually imports (main.py, bingo_scan.py, 01_CNN_refactor/*).
#
# NOTE: torch + torchvision are pulled from the CPU wheel index so they work on
# CPU-only machines (this host / Raspberry Pi). On the Mac they are CPU-only
# builds too. Install with:
#   pip install -r requirements.txt
#   pip install torch torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
# (omit the second line if torch is already installed from this wheel index).
#
# The CNN reader needs torch; the tesseract ("default") reader works without it.
